takeOffSection.title: Take Off with Dubai Airport Free Zone
paragraphs: Setting up your company in the Dubai Airport Free Zone (DAFZA) gives you a powerful advantage at the crossroads of global trade and logistics.

Strategically located next to Dubai International Airport, DAFZA offers businesses seamless access to more than 150 destinations worldwide. It's the perfect hub for companies that need speed, connectivity, and international credibility.
Whether you're in aviation, logistics, trading, technology, pharmaceuticals, or e-commerce — DAFZA provides world-class infrastructure to expand your business globally.

sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about Dubai Airport Free Zone.

items.q: What is the timeframe for registering a company in DAFZA?
items.a: Establishing a company in DAFZA generally takes 3-5 working days with proper documentation. We handle the process from application to approval.

items.q: Am I allowed 100% ownership in my DAFZA company as a foreigner?
items.a: Yes. DAFZA allows 100% foreign ownership — no local sponsor required.

items.q: What type of license should I select for my business in DAFZA?
items.a: Commercial (trading/distribution), Industrial (light manufacturing), Professional (consulting/services), or E-commerce license — based on your activity.

items.q: Do I require a physical office in DAFZA?
items.a: Yes, DAFZA requires a physical office or flexi-desk. We help you choose the right workspace that fits your budget.

items.q: Can you assist with banking services?
items.a: Yes. We help open corporate bank accounts with top UAE banks based on your business profile.

items.q: What are the available visa options?
items.a: Investor Visa, Employment Visa, Freelancer Visa, Family Visa, and Visa Renewal/Cancellation services — all fully supported.

items.q: Is DAFZA suited for e-commerce companies?
items.a: Yes. DAFZA offers E-commerce licenses and world-class logistics infrastructure for online businesses.

items.q: Can I import and re-export goods from DAFZA?
items.a: Yes. DAFZA is designed for import, export, and re-export operations with advanced customs services and duty benefits.
